events.title: [DEMO] `ProvideFeedback` parameter deprecated on POST Messages.json
events.summary: SIMULATED EVENT for the Tracewise demo, not a real Twilio announcement. A parameter of the Messages resource is deprecated; the endpoint itself continues to work.

evidence.label: Simulated deprecation notice
evidence.detail: The ProvideFeedback parameter will be ignored after 2027-01-15.

events.remediation: Stop sending ProvideFeedback in message-create requests and use the dedicated Feedback resource where available.
